text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whew...♪ I can stay cooped up in my stronghold all day today!
Maybe I'll unbox that new board game and go all out—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ruler, good timing.
I'm sorry, but could you lend me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh? How unusual.
Is something troubling you, Air Groove-san?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...So, what on earth is that?
That mountain of stacked boxes over there."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The new equipment arrived earlier than scheduled.
We must secure some space immediately.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, if we are to sort out what to dispose of at the same time...
we will need someone who is rather quick on their feet.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see... As expected of Air Groove-san.
You certainly know how to play the card that is me.
Including the fact that I can hardly refuse a request from you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Then let's wrap this up quickly.
I've got a mountain of things I want to do myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, my apologies.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... completely untouched, from square one?
Now this is... quite a challenging job.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: There's no way we'll ever finish this in time!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Move that corner to... For now... carry it out.........

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now, Ruler, I assume you understand the situation.
First, everyone let's start cleaning up—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Before I help out—
I have a request, Air Groove-san.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Give me full command.
In exchange... I'll settle this within two and a half hours.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
First, strategy. Let's optimize the unit composition.
Estimating roles and numbers is a battle fought before the board.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Next, tactics. The key to victory lies in deploying two units simultaneously
while preventing their battlefields from overlapping."

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um... could that perhaps be
about a video game or something...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...No, that's fine.
When it comes to Ruler, that's valid too."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then—
let us make our move upon the board...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Team A handles inspection and temporary removal of discarded items.
Team B handles inspection and delivery of new equipment.
We'll execute this as a two-front operation!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
First, I want everyone to focus their full efforts on the inspection.
Now... let's move out!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —Alright, that'll do.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
All preparations are complete.
All that's left is—to carry out the loading and unloading simultaneously.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san, please follow the steps written there
to temporarily move out the discarded items.
I'll direct the team bringing the new ones in.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Taking into account the shape of the cargo and the expected time of use,
the loading order has already been completely finalized.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The storage space calculation is tight, but it'll fit!
If you don't want to work overtime, don't put things in the wrong spot!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Clear a space over there for two large boxes!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Bringing in two large props!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The loading and unloading are in perfect sync.
Not bad, Ruler.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I? A battle is half formation,
half execution. There are no flaws in my plan.
choice_data_list: I was wondering why you weren't replying, and here you are...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Trainer?
...Whoa, my bad. Didn't notice your message.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, I'm in the middle of quite a massive task.
All that's left is to grind through it, but—
choice_data_list: So the Ruler of the Board really stole the show, huh.
Looks like the battle is reaching its climax.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh... Well, good enough in its own way.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However, good command alone will not accomplish the deed.
Only having an excellent unit to command makes it possible.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I suppose this is simply
the fruit of Air Groove-san's tutelage."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... Flattery won't earn you a bonus, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You were a big help today. Thanks.
How about it? Care to join everyone for some tea—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I'll pass.
I've got a place of my own where I belong.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's the perfect hideout to immerse myself in tactical research...
all to pursue that supreme move, of course.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh... That's true. However, once you enter the "endgame" phase, something else becomes crucial.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The troop headcount—
when it comes down to it, numbers are everything."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll make good use of the reinforcements, Trainer.
This is the final move to checkmate.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's all for victory, and to get back to my stronghold as quickly as possible.
May I count on your cooperation, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Phew, it's over...!!
Now it's finally time for video games.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Come along with me, Trainer.
A little bit won't hurt, right?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A new board game arrived.
For me, today... isn't wrapping up, it's just getting started.
